title: Lumbar facet joint force under 7.5 Nm, in vitro range (Wilson 2006, re-plotted in Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: facet joint force
quantity.definition: range (min-max) of facet joint contact force measured in vitro, red bars in Fig 2c; only extension and axial rotation shown; text gives centres 30 N (extension) and 83 N (axial rotation)

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.sample: as in Wilson et al. 2006 (J Biomech 39:348) - see primary; human cadaveric lumbar specimens, facet force by Tekscan film (primary: Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR 2006)

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm; facet force (N), not contact pressure.
how_to_simulate: Apply 7.5 Nm pure moment in extension and in axial rotation, no preload
Extract facet contact force per joint; extension: average left/right; axial rotation: the loaded (higher) side
Compare per-level forces with the in vitro range
protocol.notes: Secondary. Wilson 2006 is a method-validation paper (also extracted by another fork from the primary; shared). Dreischarf: model FJF at all levels L1-L5 compared to this range. Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.from: Fig 2c (red range bars) and Results text (centres 30 N, 83 N)
extraction.check_notes: Axis: gridline rows 26..128 every 20 N (14.56 px), zero at 142.5. Red pixels: extension rows 106-135 -> 50.2/10.3 N; AR rows 63-103 -> 109.2/54.3 N. Midpoints 30.2 and 81.8 vs text 30 and 83 N - within uncertainty. Flexion item carries no values.

pass_rule.rule: min <= model <= max, widened for method bias (Wilson 2006)
